description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of articles across the political leanings of media outlets, as presented in the context of narrative media framing in political discourse. The chart is divided into four total slices, which are arranged visually in descending order of size moving counter-clockwise starting from the upper right. The largest slice, labeled "Right bias," is colored blue and accounts for 30.0% (with a raw count of 30) of the total. Moving counter-clockwise, the next slice is "Left bias," which is orange and represents 28.0% (28). This is followed by the green "Questionable source" slice at 22.0% (22), and finally the smallest red slice, labeled "Left center bias," at 20.0% (20). The chart does not utilize a separate legend; instead, category text labels are placed directly outside their respective segments. Additionally, both the percentage and the corresponding raw numerical count (enclosed in parentheses) are centered inside each slice. None of the segments are visually emphasized, exploded, offset, or bolded.
